svg.title: Liquid inventory increased in four absorber-free runs
svg.desc: Inventory panel from Project/experiments/phase-08-storyline-reconstruction/stage-02-fine-mesh-simple/direct-student-342k/n3000/figures/four-mesh-inventory-and-net-outlet.png. Original PNG pixels are preserved. The four traces are 60k F0 mixed feed, 342k, 680k and 997k. Feed setup and relaxation controls differ, so this plot does not isolate mesh effects. Lines connect saved samples at solver iterations 0, 1000, 2000 and 3000.
